title: Templates.
lede: Start-from-GitHub templates I maintain. One-click on a platform that fits, or clone and run — zero npm dependencies, all party details in a single JSON file, nothing to fight.

items.name: Spooky Invite
items.tagline: A Halloween party invite that gets spookier as the night approaches.
items.description: Countdown with escalating creepiness (fog, cobwebs, a blood-red sky in the final hours), RSVPs in SQLite, and a one-night-only live race map showing every guest's walking route to the door. One HTML file, one Node server, no dependencies.
items.imageAlt: Spooky Invite preview: glowing Halloween title with date, time and venue

ctaHtml: Open a template, hit Use this template on GitHub, then cp config.example.json config.json, fill in your details, and node server.js. Each README covers Docker, VPS, PaaS and one-click deploys.
moreHtml: New Year countdown, birthday invite, and others are planned — this page grows as they ship.
metaDescription: Calvin Dsouza — GitHub templates: party invites and countdowns you can deploy in one click.
